// Schema VERSION 1 of the migration spike. Copied to lib/mig_record.dart by
// mig_versions/use.sh; do not edit lib/mig_record.dart directly.
import 'package:isar_community/isar.dart';

part 'mig_record.g.dart';

const migVersion = 1;

@collection
class MigRecord {
  Id id = Isar.autoIncrement;

  late String uuid; // v2 adds a unique index
  late String title; // v2 renames to `name`, keeping the stored name
  late String note; // v2 renames to `comment` WITHOUT keeping the stored name
  late int legacyCount; // v2 removes this
  late int size; // v2 changes the type to String
}

Future<List<String>> runMigStep(Isar isar) async {
  final out = <String>[];
  final c = isar.migRecords;
  final count = await c.count();
  if (count == 0) {
    await isar.writeTxn(
      () => c.putAll([
        for (var i = 1; i <= 1000; i++)
          MigRecord()
            ..uuid = 'mig-$i'
            ..title = 'Title $i'
            ..note = 'Note $i'
            ..legacyCount = i * 2
            ..size = i * 100,
      ]),
    );
    out.add('v1 SEEDED rows=${await c.count()}');
    return out;
  }

  // Reached only when an older app version opens a database that a newer
  // version already migrated: the downgrade case.
  out.add('v1 REOPENED (downgrade) rows=$count');
  final r1 = (await c.get(1))!;
  out.add(
    'v1 old row 1: uuid=${r1.uuid} title=${r1.title} note="${r1.note}" '
    'legacyCount=${r1.legacyCount} size=${r1.size}',
  );
  final r1001 = await c.get(1001);
  out.add(
    r1001 == null
        ? 'v1 row 1001 (written by v2): missing'
        : 'v1 row 1001 (written by v2): uuid=${r1001.uuid} '
              'title=${r1001.title} note="${r1001.note}" '
              'legacyCount=${r1001.legacyCount} size=${r1001.size}',
  );
  return out;
}
